shard.name: Mail Server (Mailpit)
shard.description: High-performance standalone SMTP mail server with an integrated webmail UI, REST API, and message inspector. Ideal for hosting mail services, password-reset testing, and Discord bot email handling.
shard.author: Axllent & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Mailpit Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl tar

cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$(uname -m)
if [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
    BIN_ARCH="linux-amd64"
elif [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then
    BIN_ARCH="linux-arm64"
else
    BIN_ARCH="linux-amd64"
fi

echo "Downloading Mailpit for $BIN_ARCH..."
curl -sSL "https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/releases/latest/download/mailpit-${BIN_ARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -xz mailpit
chmod +x mailpit

echo "Mailpit installation completed!"

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: Port used by applications to send emails via SMTP.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra flags passed to mailpit (e.g. --smtp-auth-accept-any or --smtp-auth "user:pass").
